segments.t: When Denis brings Viktor's order into the kitchen, Senya and Fedya decide to get revenge for Viktor's insults by plating a prank dish, while Max brings Vika back from the clinic. Listen to their Russian conversation first.
Ну, перелома нет, всего лишь царапина.
А если он меня убьёт случайно?
Let's look closely at each Russian line in this scene.
'Just look who showed up.' The past-tense verb ending marks the grammatical gender and number of the subject directly.
'What did he order?' Senya centers this short reply on 'ordered', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'The chef's special.' Notice how Russian puts 'dish' and 'chef' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'He will get a dish alright.' Here Senya anchors the thought on 'will be' and finishes on 'dish', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'The chef's special is ready.' In everyday Russian, 'dish' flows straight into 'ready' without extra linking words.
'That name is in French.' Senya centers this short reply on 'in French', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'It sounds beautiful.' Notice how Russian puts 'sounds' and 'beautifully' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'Vika, well, what do you think?' Here Max anchors the thought on 'Vika' and finishes on 'think, suppose', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
Ну, перелома нет, всего лишь царапина.
'Well, there is no fracture, it is only a scratch.' In everyday Russian, 'only' flows straight into 'a scratch' without extra linking words.
А если он меня убьёт случайно?
'And what if he kills me by accident?' The past-tense verb ending marks the grammatical gender and number of the subject directly.

'I promise he will not mess up again.' Putting the short word for 'not' right in front of the action word is all Russian needs to make a sentence negative, with no extra helper words like 'do' or 'did'.

'This is for you. What?' Max keeps this everyday Russian response short and direct, without needing English helper words like 'am', 'is', or 'are'. With all the phrases clear, listen to the full Russian dialogue again.
Ну, перелома нет, всего лишь царапина.
А если он меня убьёт случайно?
That wraps up the kitchen's prank dish and Max's return from the clinic with Vika. Listen for how Russian expresses promises and reassurance. Until next time!
